cases.prompt: Use bleed for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Capture page state, viewport, font readiness, and plate boundaries; preserve text extraction when the engine permits.
Check image boundaries and heading continuity; disclose raster-only accessibility limitations.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use bleed with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use bleed with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Use precise edge-to-edge composition with readable type and generous internal spacing.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
